notes.title: MARKET GARDEN - A letter to you 📝
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Hello friends! 👋[/b][/h1][p][b]📢 I've scribbled a letter - letter for you ✍️✉️[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]🟧 [b]1:[/b] [b]INTRODUCTION[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]My name is Tom - I’m the creator of Icy Bayts, a tiny [b]one-man[/b] studio behind the game [b]Market Garden[/b], and [b]I’m on a mission to bring back old-school WW2 FPS games[/b] - the kind where history, which I’m deeply passionate about, is treated with the [b]respect and authenticity[/b] it deserves.[/p][p][/p][p]And today marks one of the most important milestones in that mission - the release of my very first game - MARKET GARDEN. On this occasion, I’d like to share a few words about what I intended [b]MARKET GARDEN[/b] to be.[/p][p][/p][p]But before I do, I want to thank all of you for your time, feedback, and shared enthusiasm.[/p][p][b]This game wouldn’t exist without you and your support.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]⬅️ [b]2:[/b] [b]PAST[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]A big part of my childhood was spent playing forgotten, budget WW2 games - the kind you’d find on a CD at a newspaper stand, often bundled five in a single oversized cardboard box, costing next to nothing. [b]Despite their flaws, those games left a mark. They sparked my love for history - and for gaming.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/b5e5d240e494c65c2335e861291a498613748f73.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Then, after earning a yellow belt in karate, my parents bought me a PlayStation 2 - and with it, access to a whole new level of historical shooter experiences: [b]Medal of Honor, Call of Duty[/b], and others. I remember wondering, [b]“Just imagine how incredible historical games will be ten years from now!”[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/0e5473b08ef1beac02f5010e98916355a2b856f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]But somewhere along the way, something went wrong. [b]Those stories stopped being told - or when they were, they no longer treated history with the respect and authenticity it deserves. The magic is gone.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🕗 [b]3:[/b] [b]PRESENT[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]I’m perfectly aware that, as for today, [b]I’m just another budget WW2 game - the kind you might’ve found at a newspaper stand [/b][i](if those still existed)[/i]. I know MARKET GARDEN has its shortcomings and imperfections. There are many things I didn’t manage to deliver - documentary-style mission intros, a longer campaign, more polished vehicle combat, more cinematic moments… the list goes on.[/p][p][/p][p]With that said - [b]every journey has to start somewhere[/b] - and I truly hope this debut [b]evokes that feeling of pulling your old PS2 out of the drawer and booting up Medal of Honor: Vanguard or some other timeless WW2 shooter. [/b]And I hope it leaves you wanting more.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]💵 [b]4:[/b] [b]PRICE & INVITATION[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]I also hope that the low price is a pleasant surprise for you![b] ❗[/b][/p][p][b]And I don’t want the low price to be seen as a compromise or a sign that the game is any less special.[/b][/p][p][b]I’d rather you see it as an invitation![/b] [b]✉️[/b][/p][p]Just like I was once drawn into this world by fairly and accessibly priced games, [b]I’d love for MARKET GARDEN to leave a mark on you - and maybe even reignite your love for history and for historical FPS games.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]➡️ [b]5:[/b] [b]FUTURE[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]MARKET GARDEN is just the beginning[/b]. And the more of you that accept this invitation and join me on this mission, the closer we’ll get to [b]restoring the golden age of historical shooters.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for being part of this journey.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/95efd2b5645a5dc92c9b9059eebc580ce6689901.png"][/img][/p][h3]All the best,[/h3][h2][b]Tom | Icy Bayts[/b][/h2]

notes.title: 🔥MARKET GARDEN - Release date trailer!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Hello friends! 👋[/b][/h1][p][b]📢 It’s time for a big announcement — are you ready?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The moment has come… 🎉[/p][p]I'm thrilled to officially announce the [b]release date[/b] of [b]MARKET GARDEN[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]🚨 [b]MARKET GARDEN launches on August 1st![/b][/p][p][/p][p]For this occasion, I'm really excited to share a new Release Date trailer, which shows some never-before-seen locations![/p][p][/p][p][b]🎬 You can watch release date trailer here:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cXTEUdmZRl0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]🛠️ Also, feel free to check out the [b]refreshed MARKET GARDEN Steam Store page[/b] — with [b]new GIFs, updated screenshots[/b], fresh info, and plenty of exciting news![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/e9641ad1619900c8bed06ff682afe6b75be87fad.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you’re as excited as I am — and that you’ll have a great time playing when the game launches![/p][p]All the best,
[b]Tom | Icy Bayts[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ MARKET GARDEN - Update 0.1 - Fixes & Improvements!
notes.notes:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"][/img][/h1][p][/p][h1][b]Hello friends! 👋[/b][/h1][p][b]Your feedback over the past few days has been absolutely priceless — thank you from the bottom of my heart. ❤️[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This update brings a mix of bug fixes, ultrawide monitor support, community-suggested changes, and a range of quality-of-life improvements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]📝 Note:[/b][/p][p]It’s not required to delete your old profile and create a new one — but it’s recommended, especially if you run into any issues.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]✅ Ultrawide monitors support added[/b][/p][p][i]Improved experience for ultrawide monitor users. This feature is still experimental — if you run into any issues, don’t hesitate to reach out![/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Seamless input switching[/b][/p][p][i]Improved behavior when using both a controller and mouse/keyboard. You can now switch between them at any time — no need to disconnect your controller![/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Music volume setting[/b] [/p][p][i]Adjust music volume to your liking.[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]New aim sensitivity option[/b] [/p][p]Customize sensitivity while aiming for better precision.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Bolt-action improvements[/b] [/p][p]No more instant snapback! After firing, the view now stays zoomed-in briefly so you can see if your shot landed before entering the reload animation. Also, when holding the right mouse button, you’ll automatically return to aiming after cycling the bolt.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Invert controls (vertical axis only)[/b][/p][p]Invert mouse option now works as intended — only the vertical axis is affected.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Custom key bindings for weapon switching[/b] [/p][p]You can now rebind keyboard keys for switching weapons.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Pixelization effect disabled by default[/b] [/p][p]I noticed many of you turning pixelization off right away — I hear you! It’s now set to 0 by default for a crisper look.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Faster item pickup[/b][/p][p]Items are now picked up more quickly for smoother gameplay.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Smoke grenade performance improvements[/b] [/p][p]Reduced the performance impact of smoke grenades, especially on Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]MP40 aim alignment adjusted[/b]
Improved alignment for better accuracy.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Friendly fire from allies disabled[/b]
Allies will no longer deal damage to the player.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Steam Deck mouse support[/b] [/p][p]Due to new seamless input switching - mouse now works correctly on Steam Deck.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Improved AI line of sight behavior[/b] [/p][p]AI now handles obstacles and line of sight more intelligently.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Reload bug fix after UI change[/b] [/p][p]Resolved issue where reload prompt could behave incorrectly after weapon change.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Various minor fixes and polish[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]If your suggestion didn’t make it into this update — don’t worry![/b][/p][p]This is just one of many improvements to come. If you run into any issues or have an idea, feel free to reach out![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to all of you — and have fun playing the improved MARKET GARDEN demo![/p]

notes.title: MARKET GARDEN | Demo out now! 🔥
notes.notes:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/74399c907c2e77de19ca30227ecf5a94902c3e79.png"][/img][/h2][h2][b]Dear friends,[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]I'm excited to announce that the free [b]MARKET GARDEN demo[/b] is now available — just in time for the [b]June Steam Next Fest![/b][/p][p][/p][p]🎬 [b]Watch the new demo trailer here:[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="aiZmd-01epc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]🔥 Welcome to Arnhem, 1944[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This first demo gives you a taste of the action with one level set in the iconic city of [b]Arnhem[/b]. You’ll fight as a member of the [b]1st Airborne Division[/b], pushing through enemy defenses to reach the legendary bridge. [/p][p][/p][p]Keep in mind — this is just the beginning. You’ll get to explore more of Arnhem in future levels when the full game launches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/d86112d6e070999d4485afd6da3c8eaf10a09e0a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]✅📣 [b]Craving for your feedback[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]I’d love to hear what you think! Whether it’s bugs, thoughts, ideas, or suggestions — I’m all ears.
Feel free to reach out via [b]email[/b], [b]Steam discussions[/b], or even in a [b]Steam review[/b]. Don’t be a stranger![/p][p]📬 [b]Email:[/b][/p][p] [url="https://icybayts@gmail.com"]icybayts@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][b]🎦 YouTube:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@IcyBaytsYT"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]🦤 X (Formerly Twitter):[/b][/p][p][url="https://x.com/IcyBayts"]https://x.com/IcyBayts[/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚙️ Steamdeck, Steam Cloud[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]MARKET GARDEN[/i] plays great on [b]Steam Deck[/b] — while I'm still waiting on the official [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b] badge, the game has been thoroughly tested and is fully supported by me.[/p][p][/p][p]☁️ The demo also features [b]Steam Cloud[/b] support, so your progress carries across devices. Whether you're playing on desktop or Deck, your saves will sync seamlessly — play however you like.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🎖️ [b]Thank you for your support[/b][/h3][p]
This project is a [b]solo-developed passion project[/b], and your support truly means the world to me. I hope you enjoy this first look at [b]MARKET GARDEN[/b] — there’s much more to come.[/p][p][b]Have a great time — and thanks for playing![/b][/p][p]— Tom / Icy Bayts[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45519444/0a2fc787b261f0408b765fce67c89f44c40d3c38.png"][/img][/p]
